seoTitle: Sell Digital Products on Squarespace With Price and Tags
metaDescription: List a digital download in Squarespace with pricing, categories, and tags so customers can find and purchase it easily.
intro: Squarespace makes it possible to sell digital downloads like PDFs or software directly from your store in just a few minutes. This guide covers creating a Download product, uploading the file, and organizing it with pricing, categories, and tags.

steps.heading: Log in and open Products
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, select your site, then go to Products and Services and click Products to manage your listings.

steps.heading: Add a new Download product
steps.body: Click Add Product and select the Download option since you're selling a digital file rather than a physical item.

steps.heading: Enter the product details
steps.body: Add a clear product name, a persuasive description, and upload images that represent the product.

steps.heading: Upload the file and set the price
steps.body: Upload the actual digital file customers will receive, whether a PDF or software, then set a price that fits your pricing strategy.

steps.heading: Add categories and tags, then publish
steps.body: Assign categories and tags to improve navigability, then click Save and Publish to make the product live on your site.

faq.question: What file types can I sell as a digital download?
faq.answer: Common formats include PDFs and software applications, though Squarespace's Download product type supports a range of digital file formats.

faq.question: Why should I add categories and tags to a product?
faq.answer: They improve navigability, making it easier for potential buyers to browse and find related products on your site.

faq.question: Can I edit the price or description after publishing?
faq.answer: Yes, you can return to the product listing anytime to update pricing, description, or images.

faq.question: Is selling digital products different from selling physical ones on Squarespace?
faq.answer: The core setup is similar, but you'll select the Download product type and upload a file instead of managing shipping and inventory.
